hints.title: Overall Dominant Element
hints.text: If a split is valid, the dominant element in both parts must be the dominant element of the entire array.

hints.title: Count Total Frequency
hints.text: Count the overall frequency of the candidate dominant element first.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Check
hints.text: Iterate from left to right, maintaining the prefix count of the dominant element and checking if it dominates both halves.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def minimumIndex(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        counts = Counter(nums)
        dominant, total = counts.most_common(1)[0]
        left_count = 0
        for i in range(n - 1):
            if nums[i] == dominant:
                left_count += 1
            right_count = total - left_count
            left_len = i + 1
            right_len = n - left_len
            if left_count * 2 > left_len and right_count * 2 > right_len:
                return i
        return -1
```

complexity.notes: Overall dominant element frequency precomputation followed by prefix-suffix verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing the most frequent element at every possible split takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time and O(n) space using frequency map counting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that only the overall dominant element can possibly be dominant in both partitions simultaneously.
